webSearch.flow: With web search on, the text of each search leaves this installation for public search engines, also from a workspace whose browsing is locked to a list. Opening a result still follows this workspace's egress rules: a site outside the list asks first.
webSearch.frozen: Runs already started keep the setting they started with.
webSearch.intro: Web search is on by default when this server has a search service. An Owner or Admin can turn it off for this workspace.
webSearch.notConfigured: This server has no search service connected. Ask the person who runs Deskmates to connect one before turning on web search.
webSearch.strategyNote: Web search is part of this workspace’s network settings. Turn it off if its data must stay out of public search queries.
webSearch.title: Web search
